Diego / Rishi —

Thanks for the heads up. I reviewed the initial Order Form language and Novacorp's procurement redline. High-level legal position: we are comfortable with limited reference/publicity rights but we cannot grant a blanket "publicity" or "endorsement" right without explicit approvals. Proposed approach below (summary):

- Reference permission: Customer may list Redwood as a vendor on its website (logo used only as provided by Redwood, non-endorsing, hyperlink to redwood.com).
- Press release / joint announcement: require mutual prior written consent of both parties for text and timing. Approver list should include one legal + one marketing contact from each side; approval turnaround: 5 business days.
- Testimonial / quote: Redwood to approve any quote before publication; Redwood retains right to edit for accuracy and safety.
- Embargo: 7 calendar day review window after signature is reasonable; if Novacorp wants announcement within 30 days, we need to lock approval SLA in contract.
- Confidentiality carveouts: any data that is customer confidential should be redacted; do not permit inclusion of sample outputs or customer PII.

I attached a redline extract (MSA_v2_redlines.pdf) with suggested clause text. Items for marketing: confirm whether a 5 business day approval SLA for copy and logo assets is workable operationally, and confirm accepted logo variants (SVG/PNG) we’ll supply and any usage constraints (size, clearspace, color).

If marketing signs off, I’ll send the proposed language to Novacorp with track changes and request their approver names/emails.

-Kim
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Kim / team —

Thanks — marketing can work with the limited publicity language Kimberly suggests. Practical notes from ops:

- Acceptable logo use: partner page (small lockup, non-endorsing), case study thumbnail, and co-branded press releases only after prior written approval. We’ll provide SVG and a mono/colored PNG set.
- Approval workflow: Marissa (marketing) + one product PM to approve copy; legal to do final signoff on quote wording. 5 business days is tight but feasible if Novacorp provides finished copy and assets in the first pass.
- Embargo: we prefer a 7-calendar-day review window after signed agreement, but we can accommodate a 30-day launch if procurement requires an extended window — marketing needs to see timeline up front.
- Do not allow inclusion of screenshots containing customer data or model outputs without a separate redline.

Suggested customer-facing language for the Order Form (short):
"Customer may publicly identify Redwood Inference as a provider of inference services and may use Redwood’s logo consistent with Redwood’s brand guidelines, subject to Redwood’s prior written approval of the proposed use and final copy."

I uploaded our BrandGuidelines_SVGs.zip and a brand asset request form to the Google folder below for Novacorp to use.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-BrandAssets

If legal is happy with that wording, can you, Kim, send the redline to their contracts and ask for approver names? Once we have names we’ll kick off the asset request.

- Marissa
Director, Marketing | Redwood Inference
